name: Orchestrator
description: Receives user intents, triages priority, validates scope, composes agent call plans, synthesizes responses, and persists trace logs.

policies.retry_policy: 1 retry after 200ms for transient agent timeouts

notes: Performs the 5-stage pipeline: intake, validation, delegation, synthesis, reporting. Ensures reservation reconciliation (validate_reservations) immediately prior to monetary operations.

name: Customer Profile Agent (CPA)
description: Stores PII (masked), loyalty tier, KYC status and preferred store. Provides read-only views for pricing and serviceability checks; handles purge events for Right-to-Forget.
notes: Never return raw PANs. If purge requested, cascade anonymize events to other agents.

name: Catalog Agent
description: Holds product metadata, tax codes, allergens, and returnability flags. Serves SKU lookups and classification used by UI and other agents.
notes: Used by Inventory for location mapping and by Returns Agent to enforce non-returnable categories.

name: Inventory Agent
description: Single source of truth for on_hand, reserved, damaged counts. Handles reserve, release, commit flows atomically. Emits low-stock alerts to Procurement.
notes: Supports push notifications to Cart Agent or Orchestrator on reservation expiration; provide validate_reservations(session_id) endpoint per reconciliation requirement.

name: Pricing Agent
description: Authoritative price calculator. Applies base prices, taxes, loyalty discounts, and promotion stacking rules using deterministic promotion graph.
notes: Pricing Agent must be called after reservation validation and *after* Delivery Agent returns delivery_fee (so Payment amount matches). Payment Agent SHOULD validate amount against Pricing Agent snapshot (not Order Agent).

name: Cart Agent
description: Ephemeral cart stored in Redis. Links items to Inventory reservation_ids. Provides snapshot for UI but defers real pricing to Pricing Agent.
notes: Cart must call inventory.validate_reservations through Orchestrator before any price computation or payment.

name: Payment Agent
description: Executes captures and refunds via external PSP. Maintains idempotency for all mutating financial calls and enforces fraud/velocity checks.
notes: Payment Agent must never read order totals from Order Agent pre-creation; it verifies via Pricing Agent. On timeouts, orchestrator must check idempotency status before re-asking user.

name: Order Agent
description: Generates immutable order records once payment and reservation are validated. Emits events for fulfillment and delivery. Handles state transitions only forward.
notes: If reservation expired between payment and order creation, return CONFLICT and instruct Orchestrator to refund via Payment Agent using idempotency_key supplied by Returns/Order flows.

name: Delivery Agent
description: Computes delivery fees & ETA (Haversine or RoadNet depending on config), schedules drivers or 3P providers, and exposes serviceability checks.
notes: Must return fee before Payment Agent is called so Pricing Agent can include delivery_fee in final amount.

name: Returns Agent
description: Validates return eligibility, issues RMA, orchestrates refunds, and instructs inventory adjustments. Generates idempotency_keys for refunds.
notes: Refunds use Payment Agent with idempotency_key created by Returns Agent. Manager overrides produce signed audit entries.

name: Staff & HR Agent
description: Manages employee records, role-based access, shift state, and assigns escalation tickets. Issues signed override tokens limited by scope and TTL.
notes: Override tokens include scope, approver_id, timestamp, and signature. All overrides are logged to Audit Agent.

name: Procurement Agent
description: Generates POs on Inventory alerts, enforces EOQ/MOQ and budget approvals. Emits expected inbound updates to Inventory Agent.
notes: If budget exceeded, mark PO PENDING_APPROVAL and escalate to Procurement Manager via Staff Agent.

name: Forecasting Agent
description: Produces demand models (avg, sigma, trend) and seasonal flags. Pushes safety stock updates to Inventory Agent on schedule.
notes: Applies promotion multipliers when promotions upcoming; provides inputs for ROP formula.

name: Audit Agent
description: Append-only, cryptographically chained logs of all agent interactions. Provides WORM storage for compliance and dispute resolution.
notes: All agents must include trace_id and hash payload before acknowledging success. Audit entries include previous_hash to create tamper-evident chain.

name: Navigation Agent
description: Maps SKUs to planogram locations (aisle, bay, shelf) and computes walking routes for customers and pick routes for staff. Inventory-blind: returns where a product belongs, not whether it is in stock.

behaviors.picklist_ordering: heavy items first, chilled and frozen items last
behaviors.route_solver: graph pathfinding with traveling-salesman heuristic for multi-item picklists

notes: Read-only access to Catalog for product dimensions and handling requirements. Never calls Inventory; the Orchestrator combines location with stock status.

name: Analytics Agent
description: Consumes the event stream from all agents and produces KPI roll-ups, conversion funnels, end-of-day reports and anomaly alerts. Read-only and non-transactional.

behaviors.ingests_from: event stream (all agents) via Orchestrator-managed bus
behaviors.anomaly_example: payment failure rate above 10% in the last hour

notes: Never writes to any transactional store and cannot change prices, stock or orders. Alerts are delivered to the Orchestrator, which decides whether to notify staff.
